title: Relevance pipeline quickdemo canvas and output examples
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact set of onboarding visuals and a quickdemo canvas that clearly demonstrates Redwood's embeddings + rerank pipeline. Assets include a stepper-style pipeline diagram, three hero screenshots (Console step-through, Docs hero art, and mobile preview), annotated sample outputs (before/after rerank), and a lightweight interactive storyboard for the docs quickstart. Goal: reduce first-run confusion and provide copy/paste assets for docs, blog, and marketing with clear developer-focused callouts.
acceptance_criteria: Step-by-step pipeline diagram (SVG) that matches current Console flow and API names
Three screenshot variants exported at 2x for docs and 1x for in-product: Console walkthrough, docs hero, mobile preview
Annotated sample outputs showing raw embeddings similarity scores, rerank scores, and final ranked list with short blurbs
Figma file with named layers and tokens for rapid translation/localization
Design review sign-off from PM and Eng and linked PR for Console screenshot assets
decisions: Use stepper diagram instead of full swimlane to keep onboarding page compact
Show both cosine similarity and rerank score columns in sample outputs for transparency
Highlight API names exactly as in current SDK (embeddings.create, rerank.rank) to avoid drift
Export hero screenshots at 1440px width for docs hero and 480px for mobile preview
